topics.label: Available connectors
topics.answer: Skills, Brain, Documents, and Repo use configured local or reviewed workflows. Direct database and website/URL connectors are proposed, not available.

topics.label: Use existing data
topics.answer: Keep the originals and prepare a searchable view of the authorized scope. A directory rewrite, migration, or new table is not required.

topics.label: Start a collection
topics.answer: After the user asks to create it, make a small, factual collection in their project, such as an INDEX.md and coherent records. It still needs preparation and review before it is connected.

topics.label: Custom names and adapters
topics.answer: A chosen display name can reuse an existing reviewed workflow. A genuinely new source needs an implemented, verified adapter; a name does not create fetching or syncing.

topics.label: Register and set up
topics.answer: Identify the source scope and audience, inspect existing setup, then reuse or prepare a reviewed dataset/pointer. For opt-in memory, inspect the panel first with `python3 <skill-directory>/dispatch.py memory --describe`.

topics.label: Quick Start for New Agents
topics.answer: Quick start: `skills` discovers configured local skills; `find` searches a selected reviewed dataset; `check` checks a claim; `verify` verifies agent work; `memory` is opt-in approved-answer reuse. For a known connection, use its tool and dataset/pointer directly. For initial setup, identify authorized scope, inspect existing setup, then reuse or prepare a reviewed dataset/pointer; inspect memory first with `python3 <skill-directory>/dispatch.py memory --describe`. Fresh results still need review and explicit approval before an exact repeat can reuse them; no semantic cache or automatic refresh is provided.

topics.label: Source changes and refresh
topics.answer: Connected means registered, not automatically synced. Changed local files need reviewed preparation rebuilt and re-registration. For an export or copy, obtain its newer version first; unchanged copies cannot detect upstream changes. With no source, create an authorized factual record before onboarding. Snapshot answers do not establish currentness; current mode requires a trusted whole-scope freshness check. Never substitute cache approval time for a source check. Automatic fetching/syncing is not provided.

topics.label: Verify and save answers
topics.answer: Verified reuse is opt-in. Review the returned evidence and explicitly approve a complete answer; an exact repeat can then reuse that approved answer. There is no semantic cache reuse.

topics.label: Scope and privacy
topics.answer: A connector covers only its selected authorized scope. Repository membership or a local principal label does not itself grant access or provide authentication.

topics.label: Settings and control panel
topics.answer: Use `python3 <skill-directory>/dispatch.py memory --describe` to inspect memory actions, settings, prerequisites, and limits without configuration or a key. It does not create or change a connection.
